title: feat(ui): an approval opened with no source app stays in an app instead of Setup
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92ncfFpPUpTD8314otX5oaG)_
Fixes #35505
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 审批人从首页「我的工作」、铃铛、通知或邮件链接打开一条审批时，不再默认进入系统设置应用，而是留在业务应用里：优先记录所属的应用，其次当前应用、上次用的应用、第一个应用；详情页的关闭和返回回到审批中心。
- 这是你对审批落点的裁决（选项 A），解决审批人被带进系统设置、处理后回到原始审批请求列表的问题。
- 普通审批人和管理员都会碰到；出错时最坏是审批打开在另一个业务应用里，审批本身照常可处理，改动可整体撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The ruling (option A on the card) binds four items; each is implemented as follows.

1. **Where a request opened with no source app lands.** The order is the object's own app, then the current app, then the last used app, then the first app.
   - The last three steps are one resolver, `resolveApprovalsHostSegment(apps, current, last)` in `utils/appRoute.ts`. It reads the existing `resolveHostAppSegment` and the existing `LastAppProvider` (`useLastApp().lastApp`, the `ui.app.last` preference). No second host rule is added.
   - Home's 我的工作 (the inbox link, each pending row, and approval notices), and the bell (the same three), now host the inbox with it. Outside an app the last used app is consulted before the first app; inside an app the current app answers, as before.
   - The first step stays where it was: the deep link reads the request's `object_name` and asks `objectHostAppSegment`. That function gains `{ orSetup: false }`, which stops after "an app that lists the object". Without such an app the request now stays in the app it was opened in, instead of falling to Setup.
   - `/system/approvals…` still forwards to `/apps/setup/system/approvals…` (`SystemRedirect` stays a bare redirect, as its pin requires). `AppContent` now treats the `setup` **name alias** on exactly that inbox path as "no source app". Before any app chrome mounts, it waits at most 2 s for the last used app to be read, then replaces the URL with `/apps/HOST/system/approvals` plus the original search and hash (new file `console/setupAliasApprovals.ts`). Mounting first would record Setup as the reader's last app. The canonical-address rewrite is skipped on that path so the two do not race.
2. **The way back from a deep link, and the queue.** The deep link's redirect now carries history state: `from.pathname` is the approvals inbox of the app the request opens in, and `from.label` is the inbox title. The record page's ✕ and the phone's ‹ already follow `from.pathname`, so they return to the approvals centre, not to `/apps/APP/sys_approval_request`. `RecordDetailView.tsx` and `approvalQueueAdvance.tsx` are unchanged.
   - Home and the bell open a request with `approvalQueueState(...)` over the pending rows they hold, so the page draws the counter and 「处理后打开下一条」 works. The deep link keeps that queue and only rewrites `from.pathname` to the final app's inbox.
   - The e-mail link and a notification carry the way back alone (no queue). The server's link is unchanged; `approval-service.ts` is not touched.
3. **Setup by agreement.** When Setup is the current or the last used app, the resolver answers Setup, and the request stays there. `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/system/approvals` (Setup's own address) is never moved. Zero-app approvers are not handled, per the ruling. The `setup` fallback of an inbox mounted with no app segment is unchanged.
4. **The pinned test flips.** See below.

## Tests

Pins that flip with this change (ruling item 4, and the sweep of the same rule):

| File | Test | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484.test.tsx` | "no app lists the object: the request opens under Setup, never under the unrelated app" | `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_approval_request/record/ID` | renamed "…stays in the app it was opened from, not Setup"; `/apps/probe_app/…` |
| `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.setupItemRoutesVerdict-12706.test.tsx` | "CONTROL — the approvals inbox stays reachable under the Setup segment for a refused caller" | inbox drawn at `/apps/setup/system/approvals` | renamed "…in the caller's own app"; asserts `/apps/crm/system/approvals`; the file header sentence updated |

Changed because the call shape changed, not a flip: `HomePage.myWork-12602.test.tsx`, "opens a request in the Approvals inbox of the app the user is in". The same URL is now called with a second argument (the queue's history state), so the assertion takes `expect.objectContaining({ state: … approvalQueue: true })`. Two touched harnesses (`AppContent.setupItemRoutesVerdict-12706`, `HomePage.myWork-12602`) gained the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` that `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited test file.

Swept and deliberately **not** flipped:

- `AppContent.setupObjectListVerdict-28988.test.tsx`, "CONTROL — a host route under the Setup segment is not read as an object list": its three assertions (inbox drawn, no denial, no probe) still hold. The inbox now draws after the move to the member's app. Left unchanged.
- `record-pointer-card-renderer.test.tsx`, "no app lists the object: the record opens under Setup": this is a link to the **record** a request is about, not to the request. Its host rule (owner app, else Setup as the neutral context) is `objectHostAppSegment`'s default, and the ruling does not cover it. Not changed: its callers still get the Setup step.
- `HomePage.approvalsTarget.test.tsx` names `/apps/setup/system/approvals` only in its history docblock; no assertion lands there.
- `systemRedirectTarget.test.tsx` and `bootRedirectCoverage.test.tsx` pin `SystemRedirect`'s own hop, which is unchanged.
- No doc under `content/docs/**` names this landing.

New pins, each a top-level `describe` in the component's existing harness file:

- `utils/__tests__/appRoute.test.ts`: `resolveApprovalsHostSegment`, the order tier by tier (current over last; last over first; an inactive current falls to last; neither answers, so the first app and not Setup ahead of it), Setup kept as current or last, the unloaded list. Also `isApprovalsInboxLink`, with a CONTROL.
- `utils/__tests__/objectHostApp.test.ts`: `orSetup: false` stops after the owner app.
- `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484.test.tsx` (real inbox page plus real `RecordDetailView`):
  - the e-mail link's ✕ returns to the inbox, and no queue switch shows;
  - an open carrying Home's or the bell's queue shows 「Open next after deciding」, and ✕ returns to the inbox;
  - when the owner app is another, the way back is that app's inbox;
  - CONTROL: opened from Setup, it stays in Setup.
- `HomePage.approvalsTarget.test.tsx`: last used app on a cold landing; current over last; Setup kept as last app; a pending row navigates with the queue state.
- `InboxPopover.approvalsSegment-11818.test.tsx`: the same three tiers for the bell, plus CONTROL: the "see all" drill keeps the generic host.
- `InboxPopover.rightPanel-34589.test.tsx`: "View details" hands the queue and the way back. CONTROL: "View all" hands none.
- `AppContent.setupItemRoutesVerdict-12706.test.tsx`: the alias inbox moves through tiers 4, 3 and 2, keeping `?request=`; Setup as current is moved to Setup's own address; CONTROL: Setup's own address is not moved.

<details><summary>Affected test files, local runs</summary>

At 066d80cee8, 15 files: the 8 above, plus `systemRedirectTarget`, `bootRedirectCoverage`, `HomePage.notificationDeepLink`, `InboxPopover.notificationDeepLink`, `InboxPopover.unsavedEditsLeave-13253`, `InboxPopover.viewAllTarget` and `LastAppProvider`.

```
cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 FILES_15
 Test Files  15 passed (15)
      Tests  192 passed (192)
TESTEXIT=0
pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check   -> TCEXIT=0
pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check     -> CONSOLE_TC=0 (at 6f01f71013, after the ui closure build)
```

`HomePage.myWork-12602` was not measured locally: the shared verify lock was held by a sibling run, and two 540 s waits ended in exit 99. Its reading is CI's: Test UI (10/16) was red at 066d80cee8 on that assertion, and is green at 1ed5095d52 and at the final head.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one per changed behaviour; each mutation landed through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- Remove `{ orSetup: false }` from the deep link: 1 failed / 13 passed. Fails "no app lists the object: the request stays in the app it was opened from, not Setup".
- Drop `state={state}` from the deep link's redirect: 3 failed / 11 passed. Fails all three "way back / queue" cases.
- Delete the alias `Navigate` in `AppContent`: 5 failed / 11 passed. Fails the flipped CONTROL, plus tiers 4, 3, 2 and the Setup-current case.
- Home with `resolveHostAppSegment(activeApps, currentAppName)` in place of the approvals resolver: 3 failed / 6 passed. Fails the last-app, Setup-as-last and queue cases.

Every leg ended with `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The queue Home hands on is the pending page Home holds, not only the five rows it shows. The bell's is the rows the panel lists (decided ones already dropped). When the queue runs out, the page goes to the inbox and says the list is done, as from the inbox.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md` (the "Setup's `system/*` pages" paragraph) still says a member reaches the approvals inbox under the Setup segment from the server's links. That README is outside this card's file surface, so it is left for the seat.
- `PhoneAppNavBar.tsx` reads the generic host for its Approvals tab, but only inside an app, where the current app always answers, so it is unchanged.
- The 2 s wait for the last used app mirrors the phone landing's wait. It applies only on the alias path, and only when the current app does not answer.

## Verification

Read first:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, the two early returns after the boot gate, and the canonical-rewrite effect's new guard. This is the one hop that runs before any chrome.
2. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`, `RequestDeepLink` and `deepLinkRequestState`.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/appRoute.ts`, `resolveApprovalsHostSegment`.

Two-minute check: as a member without Setup access whose last app is CRM, open `/system/approvals?request=ID` for a request whose object no app lists. Expect the request page under `/apps/CRM…`, not Setup; ✕ lands on `/apps/CRM…/system/approvals`.
